reviews.name: Rohan & Neha Mehta
reviews.comment: Sadguru Resort exceeded all our expectations! The lush green lawns, the serene sparkling pool, and the mouth-watering food made our wedding anniversary unforgettable. The staff was polite and attentive.

reviews.name: Dr. Rajesh Deshmukh
reviews.comment: We stayed in the Deluxe Family Suite 201 with our parents and two children. The rooms were spotlessly clean, huge, and right next to the swimming pool. Highly recommended for family tranquility!

reviews.name: Snehal Wankhede
reviews.comment: We hosted our sister’s engagement in the AC Banquet Hall. The decor, sound system, and catering service were seamless. Guest feedback was 10/10.

reviews.name: Nitin Kulkarni
reviews.comment: The perfect balance of work and nature. We organized a 2-day corporate brainstorming session. Fast Wi-Fi, peaceful environment, and fabulous service.
